definitions.name: R3C.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'DN' BIND 1 DN RANGE [ 'D' BIND DN D DIV 'Q' BIND Q FLOOR Q EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending.

definitions.name: R3C.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'PN' BIND 1 PN RANGE [ R3C.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Primes up to a positive integer, ascending (empty when none).

definitions.name: R3C.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV 0 GET 1 ADD 1 COLLECT RV -1 DROP CONCAT RV SUB [ 0 EQ NOT ] MAP [ 'F' BIND 1 0 F SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN RV GROUP VALUES [ 'G' BIND G 0 GET G LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Run-length encoding of an integer Vector as [ value count ] pairs.

definitions.name: R3C.REDUCE
definitions.body: 'RS' BIND 1 12 RANGE RS [ 'E' BIND '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE ] FOLD
definitions.note: Bracket String reduced by repeatedly deleting adjacent () and [] pairs (12 passes).

definitions.name: R3C.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'T' BIND T KEYS 'K' BIND T VALUES 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'M' BIND K [ 'KK' BIND T KK GET M EQ ] FILTER 0 GET
definitions.note: Record -> first key, in Record order, whose value is greatest.

definitions.name: R3C.ORDERS
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Vector of order Records.

definitions.name: R3C.QTYSKU
definitions.body: 'OS' BIND OS [ 'sku' GET ] MAP OS [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of orders -> Record from sku to total qty, skus in first-appearance order.

solutions.runs.upruns: 'XV' BIND XV 0 GET 1 COLLECT XV -1 DROP CONCAT 'XP' BIND XV XP GT R2D.STREAKS 0 [ MAX ] FOLD 1 ADD
solutions.runs.majority: 'XS' BIND XS SORT 'SS' BIND SS XS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET 'M' BIND M NIL XS [ M EQ ] FILTER LENGTH 2 MUL XS LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.number.binary: 'BN' BIND 5 0 RANGE [ 'I' BIND 2 I POW BN GT NOT ] FILTER [ 'I' BIND BN 2 I POW DIV FLOOR BN 2 I 1 ADD POW DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB STR ] MAP JOIN
solutions.number.collatz: 'NN' BIND NN 1 COLLECT 1 150 RANGE NN [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND 1 A 2 DIV A 3 MUL 1 ADD A 2 DIV FLOOR A 2 DIV EQ SELECT A 1 EQ SELECT ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 EQ NOT ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.number.digital_root: 'DN' BIND DN DN 1 SUB 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB
solutions.number.fib_index: 'FN' BIND 1 1 COLLECT 1 12 RANGE [ 1 1 ] [ 'E' BIND 'S' BIND S 1 GET S 0 GET S 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP CONCAT [ FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'BS' BIND BS CHARS 'BC' BIND 0 BC LENGTH RANGE [ 'P' BIND BC P TAKE JOIN R3C.REDUCE CHARS LENGTH 0 EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.present_mean: R2D.PRESENT 'PV' BIND PV 0 [ ADD ] FOLD PV LENGTH DIV
solutions.sensor.filled: 'XS' BIND XS R2D.PRESENT 0 GET 'F0' BIND XS F0 [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP R2D.STREAKS [ 1 EQ ] FILTER LENGTH
solutions.sensor.ratios: 'XS' BIND XS 1 DROP XS -1 DROP DIV
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'XS' BIND XS R2D.PRESENT SORT -1 GET 'M' BIND XS M DIV
solutions.orders.unpriced: R3C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.orders.tag_counts: R3C.ORDERS [ 'tags' GET ] MAP R2D.PRESENT [ UNIQUE ] MAP FLATTEN TALLY
solutions.messy.title: R2A.WORDS [ LOWER CHARS 'C' BIND C 0 GET UPPER C 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP R2B.SPACEJOIN
solutions.messy.sorted_unique: R2A.WORDS [ LOWER ] MAP UNIQUE SORT R2B.SPACEJOIN
